summary.text: Michael Johnson is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 16, which covers Lancaster and York Counties.
He is an attorney and serves on committees including Judiciary and Education.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born on November 22, 1970, in Fort Walton Beach, Florida.
His official page lists a degree from Auburn University in 1993 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1996.
He served on the Fort Mill School Board from 2005 to 2012 and on the York County Council from 2013 to 2020.
His page lists the Convention of States Patriot Award (2024) and the SC Association of Realtors Legislator of the Year (2024).
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Rules.
